$comment: ai-crew defaults. Override per user in ~/.claude/ai-crew.json and per project in .crew/config.json (project wins). Run /crew-config to generate these interactively.
$comment_reviewers: CLI reviewers: codex, gemini, antigravity (agy). Agent reviewers: opus, sonnet, fable. The chain is tried in order; the first one that runs wins.
$comment_image: Optional image generation, OFF by default. Set provider to 'agy' (Antigravity CLI) after installing and signing in to agy. Antigravity is used ONLY for images, never as a code reviewer.
